answer: Hipótesis (data-grounded): El factor de −0.9568 asociado a la finalización del título de BA (BA DEGREE COMPLETED) se sitúa entre Black y White: en una regresión logística de finalización del título BA con interacción raza×SES (referencia = White), el coeficiente de la variable Black frente a White es −0.9568 (estimación exacta −0.956778; SE=0.2154; IC 95% [−1.379, −0.535]; p=8.9e−06). Es decir, en comparación con White (categoría de referencia), Black presenta un factor de −0.9568 en el logit de completar el título BA evaluado en SES=0 (OR≈0.384); con Black como referencia el coeficiente de White sería +0.9568. La comparación no es entre Black y Hispanic (−0.716) ni entre Hispanic y White; la variante 2 (modelos separados por raza y diferencias de coeficientes por pares) no reprodujo el valor (mínima diferencia −0.7606).

payload.hypothesis: The factor of -0.9568 for BA degree completion lies between Black and White: in a logistic regression of BA DEGREE COMPLETED with a race-by-SES interaction (reference race = White), the Black-vs-White coefficient is -0.9568 (estimate -0.956778, SE=0.2154, 95% CI [-1.379, -0.535], p=8.9e-06), i.e., Black respondents show a factor of -0.9568 on the log-odds of BA completion relative to White respondents (OR approx. 0.384 at SES=0).
payload.workflow: 1) Inspected data/nls_ses_processed.csv (8,773 rows; no missing values; race levels White 5,337 / Black 2,113 / Hispanic 1,323; BA completion 3.54% White, 1.33% Black, 1.44% Hispanic). 2) Variant 1: fitted single logistic models BA ~ race * covariate (one covariate at a time: SES, ASVAB, percentile, family size, sex) with White as reference; only the race-by-SES specification reproduces -0.9568 exactly, as the Black-vs-White race coefficient. 3) Variant 2: fitted separate logistic models per race (BA ~ SES) and compared SES coefficients pairwise (differences 0.3052/0.4555/0.7606) — none equals -0.9568. 4) Reported direction (Black vs White, ref=White), standard errors and 95% CIs for all candidate coefficients, and a robustness check with the additive specification (-0.8621).
